faq.question: Can I keep my current phone number?
faq.answer: Yes! Galaxy Club is a device subscription service, not a carrier. You keep your existing phone number and carrier plan.

faq.question: What happens to my old device when I upgrade?
faq.answer: Simply return your old device when you receive your new one. We provide a prepaid shipping label and handle all recycling responsibly.

faq.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faq.answer: You can cancel after the minimum commitment period (12 months). Early cancellation incurs a fee. You must return the device in good condition.

faq.question: What if I damage my device?
faq.answer: Samsung Care+ is included! Minor repairs are covered. For major damage, there's a maximum fee based on your plan tier.

faq.question: Can I buy out my device and keep it?
faq.answer: Yes! After 12 months, you can purchase your device at a reduced price based on remaining value. Contact support for buyout pricing.

faq.question: Are accessories included?
faq.answer: Premium and Family plans include a free accessory bundle ($100 value) with each upgrade. Basic plan members get exclusive discounts.

faq.question: Can I upgrade before my cycle ends?
faq.answer: Yes, early upgrades are available with a prorated fee. Premium and Family plan members can upgrade after 6 months at a reduced early upgrade fee.

faq.question: Galaxy Club과 일반 구매의 차이는?
faq.answer: 일반 구매는 기기를 소유하지만 Galaxy Club은 월정액으로 항상 최신 기기를 사용할 수 있습니다. Care+ 포함, 액세서리 번들, 업그레이드 비용 절감 등의 혜택이 있습니다.

faq.question: 기존 기기를 Trade-in하면 Galaxy Club이 더 저렴해지나요?
faq.answer: Galaxy Club은 기기 반납형이라 별도 Trade-in과는 다릅니다. 하지만 현재 기기의 Trade-in 크레딧을 가입비나 액세서리 구매에 적용할 수 있습니다.

faq.question: 결제 방법은 어떻게 되나요?
faq.answer: 신용카드, 체크카드, Samsung Pay 등 다양한 결제 수단을 지원합니다. 매월 자동 결제되며, 결제일은 가입일 기준입니다.
